final: SELECT o.orderflow, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) as exec_count, CAST(COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) AS FLOAT) / 999.0 as fraction_of_total FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark WHERE oe.fillcount > 0 GROUP BY o.orderflow ORDER BY o.orderflow
